name: amiel-35
description: Amiel Lavon's Claude plugins: cognitive atoms (ix-skills), domain recipes built on them (ix-recipes), philosophers' reasoning methods (ghost-council).

plugins.name: ix-skills
plugins.description: Atomic knowledge-work skills for structured pipelines — critique, correction, simplify, rephrase, explorer, decision, deliver, fact-check — and advisory postures (red-team, contrarian, dixieme-homme…).

plugins.name: ix-recipes
plugins.description: Domain recipes on top of ix-skills — HR, legal, finance, procurement, product and tech deliverables, plus workflows chaining ix-skills atoms. Install ix-skills too.

plugins.name: ghost-council
plugins.description: Des philosophes encodés comme skills — la méthode, pas le personnage. Socrate, Popper, Wittgenstein, Sartre et une vingtaine d'autres, et /council pour les faire délibérer.
